about_the_game:
This DLC enables adult (uncensored) content during the romance CG scenes. You'll find a new menu in the Options screen, saying "Suggestive Content" with On/Off settings. Enabling it will change the appearance of the romance CG scenes.

Requires the main game Roommates to download:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/317300/Roommates/

content_descriptors.notes:
Contains explicit uncensored sex scenes, as well as frequent nudity.

All characters included in the game are over the age of 18.

This DLC is only for those who are of legal age and wish to see such content.
